from.place: Proof paragraph 2, the three displayed derived Hom objects: generic dg-quotient infrastructure through the recorded ancestry, specifically the finite-cone argument in the final step of lem-coef-dg-quotient-hom-cone. The triangulated structure is obtained from a general cone-closed module-category criterion, before proving invariance of the finite hull. Abstract dg-category axioms (A), (B), (C) supply the generic triangulation theorem used after the module and sign checks. Technical input: Checking octahedra after isomorphic replacement.

title: Checking octahedra after isomorphic replacement
statement: Let $\mathcal T$ be a pre-triangulated category in the sense of [def-weil-triangulated-category], with its additive integer shifts. Suppose that for every pair $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ there are a composable pair $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':Y'\to Z'$ and isomorphisms $a:X\to X'$, $b:Y\to Y'$, $c:Z\to Z'$ satisfying $bf=f'a$ and $cg=g'b$, together with distinguished triangles $(X',Y',Q_1,f',p_1,d_1)$, $(X',Z',Q_2,g'f',p_2,d_2)$ and $(Y',Z',Q_3,g',p_3,d_3)$. Suppose there are $u:Q_1\to Q_2$, $v:Q_2\to Q_3$ such that $up_1=p_2g'$, $d_2u=d_1$, $vp_2=p_3$, $d_3v=f'[1]d_2$, and the triangle $Q_1\xrightarrow{u}Q_2\xrightarrow{v}Q_3\xrightarrow{p_1[1]d_3}Q_1[1]$ is distinguished. Then $\mathcal T$ is triangulated: TR4 holds for every prescribed triple of distinguished cone triangles of any composable pair.
